text:
Predicates:
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Footballer(x) ::: x is a football player.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Club(y) ::: y is a football club.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
CommonlyKnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
Premises:
BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ CommonlyKnownAs(ailtonSilva, ailton) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995 and is known as Ailton.
Footballer(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva is a footballer.
LoanedOut(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Brazilian(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ∧ Club(flu) ::: Nautico, Braga, and Fluminense are clubs.
Conclusion:
LoanedOut(ailtonSilva, y) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to some football club.
